items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: Create an account and send your organization's details; we open its space once we have reviewed the request, and help you add your halaqat and students.

items.question: Do students need Telegram?
items.answer: No. Every message appears inside the app; Telegram is an extra option.

items.question: Can parents follow their children?
items.answer: Yes. From their account they see their children's recitations and results, and get the result of each recitation.

items.question: Does the Mushaf work offline?
items.answer: Yes, once it is downloaded from the index.

items.question: Is our data kept apart from others?
items.answer: Yes. Every organization has its own space that no one else can see.

items.question: Which languages does Hafiz support?
items.answer: Several, including Arabic, English and Turkish; everyone chooses their own.
